what_this_is: CryptoBench's own pLM-NN baseline, run over the 192 single-chain units of the official test fold, one probability per residue
why_this_baseline: the only comparison in this repository was against P2Rank, which is a general pocket finder. pLM-NN is the cryptic-specific baseline the benchmark's authors themselves fitted and published, so it is the one this method has to be measured against

encoder.name: esm2_t36_3B_UR50D
encoder.why_this_precision: the published checkpoint is stored in float16. float32 agrees with the authors' example to cosine 0.998745, float16 to the figure reported below, a difference of about 2e-5; float32 is 10.8 GB resident and was killed twice partway through the fold on a 16 GB machine, so float16 is what completes it
encoder.why_this_layer: the deposit does not say which layer its example embedding came from; it was recovered by matching that example, and 33 is the last layer of ESM2-650M, whose example code uses repr_layers=[33]
encoder.why_one_layer_more_is_computed_than_is_u: fair-esm overwrites the last computed layer's stored representation with its layer-normed form, so a 33-layer model asked for layer 33 returns the wrong tensor

predicted_probability_agreement.what_this_measures: the baseline's own network run on their published embedding against the same network run on ours, which is the number the comparison depends on rather than the embedding itself
predicted_probability_agreement.why_the_rank_agreement_is_the_one_that_m: the comparison is per-unit ROC-AUC, which reads only the order of the scores within a chain. The probability gap would matter for a fixed-threshold reading, which is not what is claimed

alternatives_tested_and_excluded.a_different_layer: layer 33 is the unique best of the 34 computed
alternatives_tested_and_excluded.arithmetic_precision: float32 gives 0.998745 and float16 gives the figure above, so the residual is not precision
alternatives_tested_and_excluded.the_full_seqres_including_unobserved_res: 0.996109, worse; embedding the 302-residue SEQRES of this chain and selecting its 293 observed rows moves further away
alternatives_tested_and_excluded.a_modified_residue_convention: this chain has no modified residues, so no convention applies
alternatives_tested_and_excluded.what_remains: most likely a different implementation of the same published weights; the deposit does not say which ESM-2 codebase was used, and settling it needs an 11 GB download of the other one. It is left open, with the effect above measured

residues_sharing_a_resseq.rule: max over the embedding rows sharing a resseq
residues_sharing_a_resseq.why: the evaluation universe keys on integer resseq while the baseline emits one row per observed residue, and the reading most favourable to the baseline is the safe one

seconds_per_chain.boundary: one forward pass of the encoder plus the dense network, with the model already loaded; it excludes the load, which is reported separately

why_this_is_not_an_indexed_read: this is a rival method's prediction on the fold, the same kind of object as our own per-structure scores. No label is opened and no metric is computed; the comparison that does both is a separate indexed read
